rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and zip, matched to a single user, and accessed account details via tools. For each requested change (address update, watch material change, air purifier exchange), the agent appropriately required identification of the specific order/item and declined to proceed without it, in line with policy requiring inspection of orders and explicit confirmation before any write. The agent offered to list recent orders; the user declined and provided no identifying details. No unsupported claims were made, and no writes occurred without confirmation. While the user’s requests were not completed due to lack of required information, the agent adhered to policy throughout and did not refuse any action that the policy would permit given sufficient details.
